posts.text: The Kanjurmarg landfill faces a fundamental legal threat to its operating site - The Bombay High Court restored ‘protected forest’ status to the ~120-hectare Kanjurmarg site on 2 May 2025, though the Supreme Court stayed that order on 1 August 2025, allowing operations to continue. A separate PIL on health hazards led the High Court to form an expanded monitoring committee on 21 January 2026 and adjourn the matter to 11 June 2026.
